metadata.title: DelcoPA ROW | Searching for the Existence of Marriage Records Online
metadata.author: Rachel Ezzell Berry
metadata.shortDescription: This video guides you through how to search for the existence of marriage records in our online database.

i'm rachel lee zelberry the register of

the topic of this video is searching for
